title: Revolt of 1857: political causes
quote: Princes' fear of annexation turned a sepoy mutiny into a wider revolt

boxes.title: Subsidiary Alliance (Wellesley, 1798)
items: Ruler **disbands own army**; keeps **British subsidiary force** at his cost
Accepts a **British Resident**; no independent **foreign policy**
No other Europeans in service; unpaid subsidy → **cede territory**

boxes.title: Doctrine of Lapse
items: Withdrawn by **Queen Victoria's Proclamation**, Allahabad, **1 November 1858**

steps: **Wajid Ali Shah** deposed, exiled to Calcutta
**Summary Settlement 1856**: taluqdars dispossessed, disarmed, forts demolished
Nawab's soldiers jobless; Awadh sepoys of Bengal Army hurt
